items.source:
Aggregation container used in the Spring Data Elasticsearch API for a single aggregation. The concrete
implementations must be provided by the code handling the direct communication with Elasticsearch.
items.translation: Spring Data Elasticsearch API 中用于单个聚合的聚合容器。具体实现必须由处理与 Elasticsearch 直接通信的代码提供。

items.source: T - the aggregation class from the used client implementation.
items.translation: T - 所用客户端实现中的聚合类。
